evidence.description: requestAPNConsent directly invokes UIApplication.shared.registerForRemoteNotifications() rather than using a supplied application dependency.
Notification methods obtain UNUserNotificationCenter.current() directly to configure categories and delegates and retrieve notification settings.
The in-app message delegate callbacks directly invoke Analytics.shared.brazeIAM to record view, dismiss, and click events.

candidates.explanation: BrazeService directly obtains operational application, notification, and analytics services through singleton accessors. These dependencies are not received through an explicit, replaceable dependency boundary.
candidates.title: Direct Singleton Service Access
